run_benchmark_array_xd: run the benchmark_array_xd function to compare Array2D, nested sequence, and flattened sequence read/write performance
run_write_arrow: run the write function to encode examples and write them to an Arrow file using ArrowWriter
run_read_unformatted: run the read_unformated function to iterate over a dataset row by row without numpy formatting
run_read_batch_numpy: run the read_batch_formatted_as_numpy function to read dataset rows in batches with numpy format
run_read_col_numpy: run the read_col_formatted_as_numpy function to read all columns from a dataset with numpy format
